findings.claim: In addGuests.handler.ts, the team permission check uses `isTeamAdmin(...) && isTeamOwner(...)` where `||` is intended. This reduces it to an owner-only check, so team ADMINs who are not the organizer or an attendee get FORBIDDEN even though the variable is named isTeamAdminOrOwner.

The BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS check lowercases the blacklist but compares it against the raw guest email, with no toLowerCase or extractBaseEmail normalization. Blacklisted addresses therefore pass when submitted with different casing or a plus-alias.
sendAddGuestsEmails does not respect the hideCalendarNotes setting, so hidden notes can be sent to attendees.
In onError, the toast message is the template string `${code}: ${t(msg)}`, which is never falsy. The unable_to_add_guests fallback is therefore never used, and users see raw 'CODE: key' strings.
The new action updates by bookingId only, without seat-level scoping, so on seats events guests are added to the shared booking instead of the current seat.
The MultiEmail component reassigns its function parameter `value`.

coverage: pooled issues; severity and verdict are placeholders
